execution.trigger: The successful placement of a bid by the current frontrunner
execution.state_issue: The current frontrunner can manipulate other participants to fail their bids
execution.exploitable_behavior: Attacker can cause many failed transactions

causality.transition: The requirement check on send() causes a revert unless the sender is the current frontrunner
